title: Naturality of localization derived Hom
statement: Naturality of sourcePlusHomIso under precomposition, after transport to maps into Q(L).

proof.text: Unfold sourcePlusHomIso on an arbitrary morphism. Its value is the inclusion of that morphism followed by the fixed shifted representative isomorphism.

The inclusion sends a composite to the composite of the images, and its composite with the bounded-below single functor is definitionally the unbounded single functor. Remove identity factors and reassociate.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03Q8 and 03Q9; explicit naturality of the fixed comparison maps
